# Ambica Engineers & Lubricants Ltd

> Ambica Engineers & Lubricants Ltd is a premier Indian industrial fluid power engineering supplier and stockist, providing authentic hydraulic pumps, motors, valves, European silicone-copper cushion pads for short-cycle hot presses, and complete wood panel processing solutions.

## Core Product Categories & Solutions

- [Industrial Fluid Power Catalog](https://www.ambicaengineers.in/products): Complete industrial catalog of axial piston pumps, industrial vane pumps, internal gear pumps, directional valves, and filtration systems.
- [Authorized Brands Directory](https://www.ambicaengineers.in/brands): Overview of genuine hydraulic OEM brands distributed and stocked by Ambica Engineers across India.
- [European Silicone & Copper Cushion Pads](https://www.ambicaengineers.in/products/cushion-pad-silicon-copper): High-performance silicone and twilled copper wire mesh cushion compensation pads for short-cycle melamine and laminate hot presses.
- [Wood Panel & Press Solutions](https://www.ambicaengineers.in/solutions/wood-panel): Machinery, turnkey processing lines, multi-opening hydraulic hot presses, and platen thermal insulation boards for particle board, MDF, and plywood manufacturing.

## Stockist Brands & Sourcing Partners

- [Bosch Rexroth Hydraulics](https://www.ambicaengineers.in/brands/rexroth): Axial piston pumps (A10VSO, A4VSO, A7VO) and bent-axis hydraulic motors (A6VM, A2FE) for mobile and industrial applications.
- [Polyhydron Systems](https://www.ambicaengineers.in/brands/polyhydron): High-pressure radial piston pumps (1R, 2R series), industrial valves, and cartridge systems.
- [Nachi-Fujikoshi Hydraulics](https://www.ambicaengineers.in/brands/nachi): Variable volume piston pumps (PVS, PZS series) and energy-efficient wet-solenoid directional control valves (SS-G01, SA-G03).
- [Huade Hydraulic](https://www.ambicaengineers.in/brands/huade): Variable double displacement pumps (HD-A8V), fixed displacement pumps (HD-A2F), and bent-axis motors (HD-A2FM).
- [Voith Turbo](https://www.ambicaengineers.in/brands/voith): Ultra-low-noise high-pressure internal gear pumps (IPV and IPH series).
- [Veljan Hydrair](https://www.ambicaengineers.in/brands/veljan): High-performance single and double industrial vane pumps (T6C, T7B series).
